items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin) will not travel to London and is ruled out for Week 6 vs Jaguars; Tank Dell (knee) and Jalen Pitre also out.
items.implication: Full backfield to Woody Marks as lead RB.
items.opportunity: Near-workhorse snaps/carries for Marks despite tough JAC run D.

items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts ruled out for Week 6 vs Panthers (and indefinitely) due to superficial blood clot in calf that showed movement on follow-up ultrasound; Tanner McKee to start. Originated from calf cleat in Week 4, cleared for London game but now sidelined for treatment.
items.why: Movement in small blood clot after prior clearance; health priority, possible blood thinners.
items.implication: Eagles offense without dual-threat QB; McKee streamer candidate, elevated TE/WR volume possible.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and pass-catchers in favorable matchup vs CAR.

items.text: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love DNP second straight day (ankle).
items.implication: Risk for Week 6 availability; handcuff/backup upside if out.

items.text: Eagles Saquon Barkley no practice again; DeVonta Smith upgraded to limited.
items.implication: Game-time risk; Gainwell/others if out, but with Hurts also out.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice DNP again (hamstring).
items.implication: Availability doubt; Worthy/others elevated if limited/out.

items.text: Matthew Berry loves Mike Evans as his WR4 this week vs Commanders secondary; all-in due to soft matchup and usage (season-high 36% targets recently, especially without Deebo).
items.why: WSH D buffet for pass catchers; elite target share post-Deebo injury.
items.opportunity: High target volume vs weak secondary.

items.text: Berry loves Kyren Williams (RB5) vs ARI; elite recent usage vs run-leaking D.
Berry loves Rhamondre Stevenson (RB9) vs NYJ after TreVeyon Henderson multi-week high-ankle out; prior full-snap/23-touch games show volume.
items.why: Henderson out multi-weeks unlocks 85% snaps/high touches historically.

items.text: ETR (Levitan/Silva) on Cardinals trading Marvin Harrison Jr. to HOU: Kendrick Bourne will get open more and earn more targets than MHJ did.
items.why: Scheme/fit favors Bourne target earning post-trade.
items.implication: Bourne fantasy boost in ARI; MHJ new role in HOU.

items.text: With Breece Hall week-to-week and not practicing, Jets RB snaps in two full games since injury: Braelon Allen 90, Isaiah Davis 12, Kene Nwangwu 0. Clear lead role for Allen.
items.why: Snap dominance post-Hall injury confirms hierarchy.
items.implication: Allen is the start/handcuff with massive opportunity.
items.opportunity: 90%+ snap share, all early-down and likely goal-line.

items.text: Ravens WR Ja'Kobi Lane expected back to practice 4 weeks post-wrist surgery; has shot to play this weekend. Rookie had huge camp buzz as potential Bateman ice; returns to elite 6.4 YPP offense even with Lamar missing snaps.
items.implication: Potential immediate role/target upside, vertical threat.
items.opportunity: Routes and red-zone in productive Ravens attack.

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty says feeling great, best he's felt this season.
Berry loves Drake London (WR6) vs CHI with bankable usage in solid spot.
Berry hates Jaylen Waddle (WR28) vs SEA; low yards outside one game, ugly matchup and QB issues.
items.why: 67% yards in one game; averages 16.5 otherwise; SEA tough.
